title: dnaa-3 readouts — reproduced on the dnaa-4 reference config (linear s=0.6 + F-05)
caption: All dnaa-3 readouts over the full lineage, rendered from the dnaa-4 autoregulation REFERENCE run (dnaa4_s06_F05_seed1_12gen) — the SAME configuration/parameters as dnaa-4 (linear s=0.6 + F-05, V=1.5e-3, k_h=0.025), per Rashmi 2026-06-16. Six panels (time in minutes): (1) total DnaA concentration; (2) DnaA-ATP & DnaA-ADP fraction vs the [0.2,0.5] band; (3) number of oriC (cell-cycle integrity, 1<->2); (4) DnaA in all forms (apo / ATP / ADP, bound + free); (5) total DnaA boxes free vs bound, doubling across replication; (6) cell mass. Under the autoregulation config the pool self-stabilizes (no fixed-V drift) and the DnaA-ATP fraction sits in band on this reference seed.
interpretation: This replaces the earlier fixed-V (V=0.8e-3 / V=1e-3) readouts that showed the drift the autoregulation later resolved. On the dnaa-4 reference config the readouts reproduce the correct picture: clean 12/12 cell cycle (oriC 1<->2), DnaA pool self-stabilized in band, DnaA-ATP fraction in [0.2,0.5], box doubling across replication. So the dnaa-3 plots match the dnaa-4 binding/fraction results, exactly as Rashmi asked.
